shared_or_similar_visual_information: A straight boundary separating the shaded and unshaded parts of a coordinate plane. Compare the diagonal line between the gray and white regions in the left image with the diagonal line between the gray and white regions in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: Points on the descending boundary satisfy the non-strict inequality represented by the shading. Right image: The dashed edge excludes the equality boundary of the shaded half-plane.
Rationales: The solid line in the left image admits equality. The dashed line in the right image excludes equality, even where points have been marked to locate the line.
